chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Mu'awiyah ibn Hukaym, from Abi Malik al-Hadrami, from al-Hasan ibn Hammad, who said:
I said to Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام: I perform sajdah, and my forehead falls upon an elevated spot. He said: Raise your head, then place it down again.

key_terms.الْمَوْضِعِ الْمُرْتَفِعِ: an elevated place or raised surface
key_terms.جَبْهَتِي: my forehead, the part placed on the ground in prostration

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if his forehead lands on a raised spot during sajdah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning sajdah when the forehead lands on a raised place. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام instructs the person to lift his head and then place it down again, indicating the correction of the prostration posture in salat.
